_about: The branch of Anna Kastl Zima, half-sister of the seven brothers.

anna-kastl-1865.name: Anna Kastl
anna-kastl-1865.summary: Stayed in Bohemia; her son James Zima came in 1922

facts.value: 12 March 1865, Stara Hut, house No. 3, Bohemia

sources.quote: 4. ANNA — (b) 12 Mar. 1865 at Stara Hut, House No. 3.
born 12 March 1865, in Stara Hut, Bohemia
daughter of Thomas Kastl and Barbara Kellner, and died in Bohemia.
She married Joseph Zima in Bohemia in 1887.

facts.value: Half-sister of the seven brothers. Her son James Zima came to the United States in 1922.

sources.quote: The fourth daughter, Anna, who was a half-sister to the seven Kastl brothers who settled in America, married Joseph Zima in Bohemia, in 1887. James Zima, a son of Anna and Joseph, did come to the United States in 1922.
